By rotational symmetry the origin belongs to the union exactly when lambda>=gauge_K(-v0), and then to each translate. Boundary coverage plus shared center supplies an exact radial covering proof for every point of the convex hull at equality. For regular m-gon K, inclusion of all facet normals forces n divides m and the angle congruence; the side-length ratio dominates the gauge bound for m>=2n. Standalone finite tests passed 82508 checks; infinite proof is analytic.

value.rationale: The exact classification holds for an infinite-dimensional natural class of planar convex bodies rather than a few computed examples. The two independent obstructions (center coverage and facet saturation) yield a sharp mathematical dichotomy and a rotation/divisibility resonance for all regular-polygon pairs, including attained endpoint and asymptotics. This specifies a useful exact benchmark for finite convexification and demonstrates strong instability under facet misalignment.
